name: hf_nsclc_radiomics
title: NSCLC-Radiomics (TCIA) as NIfTI: 422 lung-cancer CTs with organ and tumour segmentations
description: The Lung1 cohort of NSCLC-Radiomics (Aerts et al.), converted from TCIA DICOM + DICOM-SEG to NIfTI by farrell236. Per patient one CT and the available structures: primary tumour (GTV-1), left and right lung, heart, oesophagus, spinal cord, plus a combined label map built by the repo's combine_segmentations.py (label values below come from that script).

license.note: CC BY 3.0 on the Hub card and on the TCIA collection page; cite the data, the publication and TCIA (checked 2026-10-13).

citation: Aerts H.J.W.L., Wee L., Rios Velazquez E., et al. Data From NSCLC-Radiomics (version 4). The Cancer Imaging Archive, 2019. doi:10.7937/K9/TCIA.2015.PF0M9REI. Aerts H.J.W.L. et al. Decoding tumour phenotype by noninvasive imaging using a quantitative radiomics approach. Nat Commun 5:4006, 2014.

ct.description: Thorax CT (NIfTI, LPS mm from the header)
